description: Figure 3 presents a bar chart illustrating the results of an ablation study, likely evaluating the contribution of different components to a model’s performance. The horizontal axis displays the ablation configurations, labeled “Base,” “w/o Int,” “w/o Text,” “w/o Vis,” and “w/o Mul,” with “Base” representing the full model and the others indicating configurations with specific components removed. The horizontal axis is not sorted in any particular order. The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy (%)”, represents the accuracy values, with a linear scale ranging from 70 to 92, with tick marks at 70, 75, 80, 85, 90, and 92.  Four bars are shown for each dataset (PHEME and Politifact). For the PHEME dataset, the “Base” bar is colored dark blue and reaches approximately 89.8%, “w/o Int” is light blue and reaches approximately 86.8%, “w/o Text” is green and reaches approximately 82.4%, and “w/o Vis” is orange and reaches approximately 83.6%. For the Politifact dataset, the “Base” bar is dark blue and reaches approximately 90.6%, “w/o Int” is light blue and reaches approximately 87.6%, “w/o Text” is green and reaches approximately 84.6%, and “w/o Vis” is orange and reaches approximately 85.1%. Each bar within a dataset grouping is adjacent to one another, representing the accuracy for each ablation configuration.
